question: Calavo Growers company founded year founding location and headquarters address
markdown:
Calavo Growers
was founded on January 21, 1924, originally as the California Avocado Growers' Exchange. It was established in California, and its corporate headquarters is located at
1141-A Cummings Road, Santa Paula, CA 93060, United States
